question: Build a sponsor-level Canadian DAF panel for FY2023-FY2025 from CRA T3010 open data (lines 5860-5864), reconcile it with Blumberg & Pasha's 2024 totals ($16.64bn assets, 834 charities) and the WellFunded/futureofgood $17.3bn figure, and flag transposition errors in account counts
conclusion_affected: Whether Canada is a credible second market for a US AI-native entrant; Canadian payout vs 5% DQ

question: Has Australia amended the giving fund (ancillary fund) guidelines to the 6% minimum distribution with 3-year smoothing announced 2026-02-26, and how are sub-funds inside public giving funds treated? question: Which technology vendors run the UK DAF sponsors in NPT UK's 10-charity sample (CAF, Prism, Charities Trust, NPT UK and others)?
